name: Mário de Andrade
bio: Mário Raul de Morais Andrade (São Paulo, 1893 – São Paulo, 1945) was a poet, novelist, musicologist and critic, and the central figure of Brazilian Modernism. He was one of the organisers of the Semana de Arte Moderna held in São Paulo in February 1922.

His Paulicéia desvairada (1922), a sequence of free-verse poems on São Paulo prefaced by the manifesto 'Prefácio interessantíssimo', is counted the first modernist book of verse in Brazil. His later work includes the novel Macunaíma (1928) and extensive studies of Brazilian folk music.
